questions.question: Clarify the approximate life dates, the priority claimed for compass-and-straightedge construction and the chronology of practical applications of conic sections.

localizations.source: Clarify the approximate life dates, the priority claimed for compass-and-straightedge construction and the chronology of practical applications of conic sections.
localizations.ru: Уточнить приблизительную датировку жизни, заявленный приоритет построений циркулем и линейкой и хронологию практических применений конических сечений.

questions.resolution: The dates are now explicitly approximate, the unsupported priority claim was removed, and Kepler and Galileo are presented as important early modern examples rather than the first practical applications.
